comment: View IDs are bare (package prefix added in code, letters/digits/underscore only). Instagram renames these across updates - discover current ones with Debug mode + 'adb logcat -s ReelsBlocker', then update this file and use the in-app 'Import rules file' button (no reinstall needed). Tab descriptions must match the bottom-nav labels EXACTLY (or 'Label,...' prefix) and are locale-specific: on a non-English phone add the translated labels to selectedTabDescs and home.tabDescs (e.g. Spanish: 'Inicio', 'Buscar y explorar').
